highlights.headline: Nvidia's Jensen Huang resigned and Anthropic set its IPO for 19 November at up to US$1.4 trillion.
Kimi Antonelli is the youngest F1 champion ever; three races left, starting in Las Vegas on 21 November.
GTA VI finally launches 19 November after an estimated US$1 billion in pre-sales.
Hot US inflation makes a December Fed hike likely, while Hong Kong's Q3 GDP grew 5.2%.
Arsenal lead by five from Brighton; Man United are in the bottom three.
Bitcoin fell below US$70,000 to a three-month low on rate-hike fears.
Ka Ying Rising returns in the Jockey Club Sprint on 22 November, eyeing a third Hong Kong Sprint.
The ATP Finals start Sunday in Turin without injured champion Sinner.
